feature_computation.net_charge: Henderson-Hasselbalch net charge at pH 7.0 using side-chain pKa (K 10.5, R 12.5, H 6.0, D 3.9, E 4.1, C 8.3, Y 10.1) plus N-term pKa 9.0 and C-term pKa 2.0
feature_computation.hydrophobic_moment: Eisenberg hydrophobic moment assuming alpha-helix, 100 deg/residue, normalized by sequence length
feature_computation.boman_index: negated mean Boman (1995) side-chain transfer free energy; higher = more protein-binding potential
feature_computation.proline_fraction: fraction of residues equal to P
feature_computation.glycine_fraction: fraction of residues equal to G
feature_computation.cysteine_fraction: fraction of residues equal to C
feature_computation.hydrophobic_fraction: fraction of residues with positive Kyte-Doolittle value

esm_pooling: mean-pool per-residue hidden states, excluding BOS/EOS
ensemble_architecture: 2 independently trained models, each a Pipeline wrapping a ColumnTransformer([passthrough 16 physchem descriptors, StandardScaler->PCA(0.95 variance) over 640-dim ESM2 block]): SVC(probability=True) and a custom TorchMLPClassifier (3-layer MLP). Deployed prediction is the unweighted mean of the two models' P(angiogenic_dominant).

mlp.loss: NLLLoss over log(softmax) output, class weights [1, 5]

hyperparameters.note: class_weight/pos_class_weight of 5 reflects heavy class imbalance (23 positive / 183 negative in training data)

training_data.cleaning_filter: Sequences non-null, fullmatch [ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY]+, deduplicated by sequence; label = 'Angiogenesis ' column cast to int
